about: Community plugins for RackTicker: one folder each, installable straight from its URL. Add yours with a pull request — one entry pointing at a public GitHub folder that contains plugin.json.

plugins.name: Arcade
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: Ambient arcade: real games, played live by simple AIs at native resolution.

plugins.name: Departures
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: Live station boards: the London Underground in its own line colours, Metrolink and Amtrak across the United States, BART, and seven European stations, each drawn the way that country's boards look, with trains pulling into the platform.

plugins.name: Formula 1
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: Formula 1: a start-light gantry counting down to lights out, the last race's podium and the championship fight. Key-free Jolpica (Ergast-compatible) API.

plugins.name: Prediction markets
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: Read-only public prediction-market odds board; no trading capability.

plugins.name: Now playing
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: The song you are listening to, like an old car stereo: album art, the title and artist scrolling past, track number and time, and a segmented spectrum analyser. From Spotify or any Home Assistant media player.

plugins.name: Onboard
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: The strip map above the carriage doors, for a train that is really running: the line, the stops, the train sliding along it, the next stop and how long until it.

plugins.name: Quakes
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: Earthquakes around you from the USGS: a 24-hour seismograph drum, the latest shakes by size and distance, and a take-over when a strong one hits nearby.

plugins.name: Retro Screensavers
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: Classic desktop nostalgia in 128×32 pixels: growing 3D pipes, Mystify trails, starfield, a bouncing four-pane badge and marquee text.

plugins.name: Surf
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: The surf at your break: wave height, swell period and direction, water temperature, and real water — a simulated sea driven by the actual swell, sitting high or low with the actual tide.

plugins.name: Tanks
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: Real levels as sloshing water: California's big reservoirs, and the space station's urine and water tanks when NASA's live feed answers.

plugins.name: LED sign
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: Programmable LED sign: the storefront kind that spells words out of flying pixels, drops letters in, spins slot reels and chases marquee bulbs.

plugins.name: Freeway traffic
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: Freeway traffic board: live CHP incidents on nearby freeways, shown as a freeway shield, what happened, where, and how long ago.

plugins.name: Data from a link
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: Any number or text from a JSON web address, shown as a big clean card. No code: paste a link and the field to show.

plugins.name: Video player
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: Loops a short clip on the panel: a local file, a direct video URL, or any live stream ffmpeg can open (mp4, GIF, HLS, RTSP/RTMP). Ships playing a free demo clip out of the box.

plugins.name: Virtual Aquarium
plugins.author: Costa Mesa Tech Solutions
plugins.description: A living pixel aquarium: clownfish, angelfish, neon tetras, swaying plants and a wandering snail. Optionally mirrors real tank readings and lighting.
